problems: fixes_applied counts seven: republic-of-indonesia 5 (Aceh in keyframes 1945/1946/1947/1949/1953 and the founding and 1946 gain regions; contest 1945-10 to 1946-11 against dutch-east-indies; capital move dated on the Yogyakarta page plus Bukittinggi and return; Roem-Van Roijen gain of Yogyakarta 1949-06; PRRI/Permesta contest 1958-02 to 1961-09 with a war entry) and democratic-republic-of-vietnam 2 (Attapu and Bolaven Plateau occupation pairs mirrored from kingdom-of-laos; Chinese occupation dated August 1945). The DRV /ledger/10 confidence change was already applied by the reviewer. The 1967 trail strip date and the Paris-accords zones stay at confidence 1 with the pages' evidence added to the notes; pathet-lao (thin) and the other six dossiers were not touched.

Beyond the finding: Aceh is subtracted from the Operation Kraai contest zone (54 cells were in it) and the Operation Product zone (1 cell) of republic-of-indonesia, ledger and wars/0, because the Aceh page says the Dutch never invaded it.

DISAGREEMENT with the reviewer: the 4 January 1946 move to Yogyakarta is on neither the Yogyakarta nor the Revolution page (the Yogyakarta page says 'from 1946 to 1948'), so the month is left empty (confidence 1 to 2 on the year); the Chinese arrival is August 1945 on the August Revolution page ('starting August 1945'), not September.

Mirror needed in dutch-east-indies (se-03): a loss of the Yogyakarta region to republic-of-indonesia in 1949-06 (Roem-Van Roijen page), and a contest against revolutionary-government-of-the-republic-of-indonesia for 1958-61 if the PRRI dossier is written. republic-of-indonesia now carries two validator warnings for counterparts without dossiers (revolutionary-government-of-the-republic-of-indonesia, dutch-new-guinea).

kingdom-of-laos /ledger/5 and democratic-republic-of-vietnam /ledger/6 carry the same Cliopatria year (1967) for the trail strip; the Laotian Civil War and Ho Chi Minh trail pages place PAVN occupation of eastern Laos in 1958-59 and Attapeu in 1970, so if the date is revised both dossiers must move together.

Page budgets were exceeded on the reviewer's instruction: republic-of-indonesia opened five more pages (Aceh, Yogyakarta, Permesta, Revolutionary Government of the Republic of Indonesia, Roem-Van Roijen), democratic-republic-of-vietnam three more (August Revolution, Ho Chi Minh trail, Paris Peace Accords). The Permesta and PRRI pages disagree on dates (15 vs 17 February 1958 for the PRRI; 28 September 1961 disestablishment vs a last Permesta commander surrendering in early 1962).
